fields.letterText:
Every {0} colonist feels a wave of anxiety and anger!

Some distant darkness in the Force is stirring. A disturbance presses on this site, tuned to only affect {0}s. For a few days, some people's mood will be quite a bit worse.

The disturbance level is {1}.
fields.label: a disturbance in the Force
fields.description: A great disturbance ripples through the Force, pressing on minds and driving people towards insanity.

fields.letterText:
Every {0} colonist smiles with contentment!

The Force is at peace over this site, tuned to only affect {0}s. For a few days, some people's mood will be quite a bit better.
fields.label: the Force at peace
fields.description: The Force settles into stillness over this site, calming minds and steadying hearts.

fields.letterText: A dark-side droner has begun affecting this region.
fields.label: dark-side droner
fields.description: A dark-side droner tuned to the {0} gender is driving {0}s mad.

fields.letterText: A Force-suppression field has begun reducing the consciousness of {0}s across the whole region. The effect is modulated by an individual's psychic sensitivity.
fields.label: Force suppression field
fields.description: A Force-suppression field is affecting {0}s and reducing their consciousness. The effect is modulated by an individual's psychic sensitivity. Royalty

fields.letterText:
A large piece of an ancient ship has crashed nearby.

Your colonists can feel it in the back of their mind through the Force, exhorting unspeakable acts. A Sith relic is aboard, and it whispers to anyone near. It is not friendly.

Destroy it as soon as possible. But beware - it will probably defend itself.
fields.label: ship part crash (Sith relic)
